public_body: Minuteman Regional Vocational Technical School Committee
overall: The AG found the regional committee chair violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating by email with a quorum on the graduation date, though acting in good faith and not intentionally; compliance was ordered.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee chair emailed a quorum of the committee on a public matter (graduation date) on Feb 16-17, 2012, without public access.
allegations.key_passage: Although it is a close question, we find that the emails sent on February 16 and 17, 2012 constituted improper deliberation outside of an open meeting.

remedy: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar conduct may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar conduct may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
